payload.claim: probe_refusal's docstring (line 143-145) promises a specific order — outside-the-tree first, then empty test_paths, then the glob match — but no test exercises a file that is both outside the tree and evaluated against an empty test_paths list, so the order between the first two checks is unwitnessed. Swapping lines 147-151 so the `if not test_paths:` check runs before `_repo_relative` keeps every test in this diff green (all existing outside-tree cases use non-empty test_paths, and all empty-test_paths cases use in-tree files), while changing the reason text a probe on e.g. `../outside.py` gets when test_paths is also empty. This has no effect on the verdict or on whether the mutator is entered — both orders refuse the probe — so it is a documentation/audit-trail gap rather than a behavioral one.
